surveys.adminLead: Prepare one short survey per competition, then invite eligible participants, guardians and coordinators only after results are published.
surveys.none: There are no competitions you manage.
surveys.denied: You do not manage this competition.
surveys.builderHelp: Use 1–10 short questions, each with 2–10 distinct choices. For a rating, list the numbers 1 to 5 as choices. Do not ask for or include names, contact details or other personal information. Every question must be answered.
surveys.question: Question {number} text
surveys.sendHelp: Sending locks the questions, checks consent and current competition links, and opens the survey for 30 days.
surveys.waitForResults: Results have not been published yet. You can save a draft now and send after publication.
surveys.dashboardLead: Share feedback about the competitions you took part in or supported.
surveys.answerHelp: Taking part is optional. One response per invited person. FOA stores your selected answers with the invitation so you can answer only once, but managers see only aggregate results. Do not include personal information.
surveys.unavailable: This survey is not available, has closed, or has already been answered.
surveys.complete: Thank you for sharing your feedback.
surveys.disabled: Survey sending and answering are currently disabled.
surveys.invalid_input: Check the title, questions and choices, or choose one answer for each question.
surveys.results_not_published: Publish competition results before sending a survey.
surveys.no_recipients: No currently eligible people have consented to communications.
